name: NovaPay Metal Card
desc: Our top card tier. Brushed metal build, 2% cashback on every purchase, unlimited fee-free spending abroad and airport lounge access for two.

name: NovaPay Plus Card
desc: The everyday account card. Instant spend notifications, round-up saving, budget limits per category and free ATM withdrawals up to 1,000 a month.

name: NovaPay Travel Card
desc: Built for people who spend across borders. Interbank exchange rates in 30 currencies, no foreign transaction fee and travel disruption cover included.

name: NovaPay Business Card
desc: Company card with unlimited employee sub-cards, per-card spend rules, receipt capture and a direct feed into your accounting software.

name: Stocks Pro
desc: Commission-free trading in over 4,000 US and European stocks, fractional shares from 1 dollar, plus limit orders and recurring buys.

name: Crypto Vault
desc: Hold 40 digital assets with institutional custody, cold-storage backing and automatic monthly buys. Segregated wallets, insured up to 250,000.

name: Managed Portfolio
desc: A diversified portfolio matched to your risk profile, rebalanced automatically every quarter. Choose from cautious, balanced or adventurous.

name: Savings Boost
desc: Lifts the interest rate on your main balance to 4.85% AER, paid daily, with instant access and no withdrawal limits.

name: Goal Pots Pro
desc: Unlimited saving pots with target dates, automatic round-ups, salary splitting on payday and shared pots for up to five people.

name: Credit Builder
desc: Build a credit history with a small secured limit reported monthly to the bureaus. Your deposit stays yours and is returned when you close.

name: Personal Loan
desc: Borrow 1,000 to 25,000 over 12 to 60 months with a rate quoted before you apply and no penalty for paying it off early.

name: Multi-Currency Account
desc: Hold and convert 30 currencies in one balance with local account details in the US, UK and eurozone, so you get paid like a local.

name: Global Transfers Pro
desc: Send money to 90 countries with the mid-market rate, a flat low fee and same-day arrival on the most used corridors.

name: Travel Insurance
desc: Worldwide medical cover to 10 million, trip cancellation, delayed baggage and winter sports, for you and the family on one policy.

name: Device Insurance
desc: Covers cracked screens, liquid damage, theft and loss on up to three devices, with repair or replacement inside 48 hours.

name: Purchase Protection
desc: Refunds card purchases that arrive broken, never arrive or are not as described, up to 5,000 a year, claimed in the app in minutes.
